text:
sam: Quick heads-up: GearBridge (SI) wants a joint security advisory + marketplace listing next month. Need SSO (SAML), SCIM user sync, and KMS/HSM secrets flow validated. Can we run a 30m dry-run tomorrow? Prefer 10am PT. TL;DR: we must lock the integration checklist + embargo cadence.

mia: 10am PT works for me. I'll bring the SCIM test plan and sample user mappings.

alex: I can do KMS/HSM validation. Need access to their test HSM endpoint — @partner-ops-bot can you confirm creds & network routing?

partner-ops-bot: Created ticket PB-4821 for GearBridge test HSM access. Waiting for vendor approval. ETA 24-48h.

nina: I'll own SAML SSO test cases + metadata exchange. Also need to confirm whether GearBridge supports SP-initiated logout.

sam: Good. Also we need to define the marketplace listing embargo + joint announcement window. Marketing prefers a 48h embargo after final cert. Does that align with compliance checks?

alex: Compliance says 72h if there are legal checks. Suggest we aim for 72h and try to reduce to 48 if all tests pass.

mia: SCIM note: GearBridge uses custom group attribute 'role:cloudRole' — I'll add transformation script. Quick snippet for preview: ```python
def map_group(g):
    return {'name': g['displayName'], 'role': g.get('role:cloudRole')}
```

nina: SAML metadata exchange: I'll send our SP metadata before EOD. GearBridge will need to add our ACS and EntityID.

partner-ops-bot: Vendor approval received for HSM test endpoint. Details in PB-4821. Sharing in #secure-files.

alex: Awesome. Also planning to run load test on Dedicated flow to validate token rotation with KMS every 12h. Command I'll run: `curl -X POST https://staging-infer.redwood.local/test-rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`

deploy-bot: Deployed scim-transform v0.9.1 to staging in 3s. CI passed.

sam: Meeting invite sent for 10am PT — calendar: https://cal.example.com/meet/gearbridge-dryrun. Agenda in thread. Please add any blockers. Goal: greenlights for SSO/SCIM/KMS, and a proposed announcement cadence (target + embargo).

mia: :thumbsup: I'll upload SCIM mapping doc to the agenda. Reminder: bring sample SCIM CSV with 3 user roles.

nina: If GearBridge can't do SP logout we'll fallback to session expiry + revocation via SCIM.

alex: Ok. Will prepare rotation logs and a small runbook for KMS failure fallback.

sam: Thanks all. If vendor says no to 10am tomorrow, fallback slot 2pm PT. Otherwise see you then.
